verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export or data-portability feature for leaving the service. What it does show are developer building blocks: readFile/exec to pull files out programmatically, directory snapshots to Cloudflare's own R2, and mounting S3-compatible buckets for persistence. None of these is a documented 'export all data in open formats' capability, and none earns credit under the partial boundary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
